description: A compressor, limiter and adaptive limiter for a stereo pair, with a short delay on the signal so the gain is already down when a peak arrives

params.text: Sets the level above which the gain starts to come down, -36dB to 6dB
Sets how much of the overshoot is taken off, 1 to 8; in the Lmt and AdL settings the ratio is fixed at its hardest and this knob changes nothing
Adds level after the compression, 0dB to 12dB
Picks which envelope the gain follows: Cmp uses the slow one, Lmt the fast one, and AdL whichever of the two is higher at that moment
Scales both signals before they reach the detector and the compression, 0 to 4

inputs.text: The left signal to be compressed
The right signal to be compressed
While a cable is patched here, the gain follows this signal in place of the two being compressed

outputs.text: The left signal after compression, behind the input by the delay set in the menu
The right signal after compression, behind the input by the delay set in the menu

notes: one detector serves both signals, taking whichever of the two is louder, so the stereo image holds together under compression
menu: Delay — sets how far the signal is held back before the gain is applied, 1ms to 21ms
AttFast (Lim,ALim) — sets the attack of the fast envelope, 1ms to 20ms
RelFast (Lim,ALim) — sets the release of the fast envelope, 1ms to 100ms
AttSlow (Comp,ALim) — sets the attack of the slow envelope, 1ms to 200ms
RelSlow (Comp,ALim) — sets the release of the slow envelope, 1ms to 1 second

inputs.2:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the two signals themselves.
